ntm.interpretation: absent from ALL 53 non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes tested (incl. the closest MTBAP relatives) — a candidate MTBC-specific genetic innovation / host-adaptation factor (confirm by synteny; rule out a short/low-complexity ORF and extreme divergence)
ntm.source: presence/absence by tblastn vs ~53 assembled non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes (annotation_mtbc P10.2)

phylostratum.interpretation: absent from the whole genus and from all outgroups tested — a candidate MTBC-specific innovation (confirm by synteny; rule out detection failure for short/divergent ORFs)
